text:
maya (Finance): Heads-up — Orbit Partners flagged a -$119,874 adjustment on their consolidated Feb invoice. They say a promotional offset was applied to committed seats instead of overage. Can we triage?

billing-bot: Invoice processed: INV-2026-02-1257 | partner: Orbit Partners (ORBIT-88) | total_adjustment: -119874.00

sam (RevOps): ugh. do we have the invoice line/CSV? want to see what SKU it hit.

maya (Finance): Pasting the relevant slice from the invoice export:
```
date,partner_id,sku,charge_type,quantity,unit_price,subtotal,adjustment,net
2026-02-28,ORBIT-88,redwood:dedicated-seat,committed,200,50.00,10000.00,-119874.00,-109874.00
2026-02-28,ORBIT-88,redwood:overage-token,overage,1,0.02,15000.00,0.00,15000.00
```

lee (PartnerOps): that first line screams "promo applied to committed". Contract Appendix B only allows promo offsets to be applied against overage charges, not committed seats.

eng-billing: Confirming — our promo-application rule (apply_promo_to_overage) is set to `true` in prod, but there was a recent mapping change for Orbit that set `promo_target: committed` back on 2026-02-25. We're investigating why. Ticket BILL-4721 opened.

sam (RevOps): any chance this was a manual credit entry from partner success?

maya (Finance): Partner ops says no manual credit ticket. Orbit sent a reconciliation email complaining about the negative subtotal.

olivia (FP&A): If it's our error we need to issue a correcting credit note and adjust revenue for Feb before close. I need the proposed journal / credit note text to approve.

eng-billing: Proposed actions:
1) Reclassify the -119,874.00 from committed -> overage adjustment (so net on committed returns to 10,000.00, overage gets -119,874.00).
2) Emit a credit note CN-2026-02-0892 to Orbit Partners for $119,874.00 (reason: misapplied promotional offset).
3) Reverse revenue recognition for the misapplied portion for Feb (journal entry DR Revenue $119,874 / CR Receivable $119,874) — please confirm ledger account codes with FP&A.

maya (Finance): Sounds right. Olivia, can you approve the credit note text below?
```
Credit Note CN-2026-02-0892
Partner: Orbit Partners (ORBIT-88)
Amount: $119,874.00
Reason: Promotional offset was incorrectly applied to committed seats. Adjustment reclassified to overage per contract Appendix B.
Action: Credit issued to be applied against next invoice or refunded per partner preference.
```

olivia (FP&A): Approved. Please include the following GL codes in the JE: 4001 (Revenue), 1200 (Accounts Receivable). Also tag as "partner_credit_misc" for audit.

sam (RevOps): I will ask AP to hold payment for INV-2026-02-1257 until credit note is issued and reconciliation confirms. @billing-bot can you hold?

billing-bot: Hold request received for INV-2026-02-1257. Payment blocked until manual release. Ticket linked: BILL-4721.

lee (PartnerOps): I'll message Orbit with the expected credit note and ETA (48 hours). Keeping them in the loop.

eng-billing: Running reclassification now. If successful we'll post CN-2026-02-0892 and update invoice. Command run: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-billing.redwood/api/v1/credits \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"invoice":"INV-2026-02-1257","partner":"ORBIT-88","amount":119874.00,"reason":"Promo misapplied","reference":"BILL-4721"}'
```

maya (Finance): Thanks. Please drop the final updated invoice PDF in this thread when done.

sam (RevOps): adding :thumbsup: — will follow up with AP to confirm hold remains.

lee (PartnerOps): Orbit acknowledged receipt and asked for confirmation that future promos won't hit committed seats. I'll confirm with eng-billing on mapping fix.

eng-billing: Mapping fix deployed to prod (promo_target enforced for partners with contract_flag 'overage_only'). Added a safeguard test. Logged in BILL-4721.

maya (Finance): Great — closing this on our side once updated invoice and CN are attached. Thanks all.
